_about: How the synthetic Synthea patients are made to look like the UAE (scripts/uae_adjust.py) and how features are built (scripts/preprocess.py). published = from the named source; assumption = no published UAE value, a reasoned choice; design = a choice of this project. Changing a value and re-running the data steps changes the synthetic population.

adjust_seed.source: Random seed for the UAE adjustment (same seed, same population)

features_seed.source: Random seed for simulated attributes in preprocessing

region_share.source: Share of Abu Dhabi emirate residents by region; replace with Statistics Centre Abu Dhabi figures

place_weights.source: Relative number of residents per OpenStreetMap place type, within a region

home_jitter_degrees.source: Random spread of homes around a place centre (about 1 km), so neighbours are not stacked

road_speed_kmh.source: Average road speed by area type, used for travel time to the nearest facility

road_detour_factor.source: Road distance is about 1.3 times the straight-line distance

travel_overhead_min.source: Minutes added to every trip (parking, walking in)

facilities_radius_km.source: Radius for counting nearby health facilities

nationality_mix.source: Nationality mix; the expatriate workforce is mostly men of working age (no official Abu Dhabi breakdown by nationality is published)

work_shift_mix_south_asian_men.source: Work shifts of South Asian working-age men (more day-shift labour)

insurance_mix_day_shift.source: Insurance of non-Emiratis on day shifts; Emiratis are on Thiqa (published: Thiqa is the scheme for UAE nationals)

can_read_share.source: Share who can read a text message

smoking_rate.source: Gives the WHO 2025 UAE adult smoking rate of 8.8% overall with 64% men in the population

smoking_from_age.source: WHO tobacco indicators count people aged 15 and over

guardian_ages.source: A child's guardian is an adult of these ages, of the same nationality where possible

mcv2_target.source: WHO/UNICEF estimates 2025: UAE second measles dose coverage 92%

mmr_check_ages.source: Children checked for the second dose (Synthea keeps about 10 years of history, so older children's doses are missing)

missed_visit_model.source: Chance a well-child visit is dropped rises with the family's access barrier; scaled so the measles target is met

undiagnosed_share.source: Share of all cases not yet diagnosed; totals are matched to WHO UAE prevalence

prevalence_ages.source: Age ranges of the WHO indicators (diabetes 18+, hypertension 30-79)

recent_normal_test_days.source: A normal test in the last 6 months rules out a hidden case

hidden_case_weights.source: Who becomes a hidden case follows the log-odds of being undiagnosed among real NHANES adults (2015-2023, logistic regression of age, BMI, sex, told-prediabetes and smoking; hypertension without prediabetes). The ancestry effect (0.25) has no published value and stays an assumption

hidden_onset_years.source: A hidden case started some time in the last 5 years (after the last normal test)

hidden_values.source: The value a test would show today for a hidden case (truth file only)

consent_genetic.source: Share who allow use of genetic information

family_history_recorded.source: Share with family history in the records

family_history_diabetes.source: Odds ratio about 4.6, close to NHANES 1999-2002 (diabetes in 14.3% with a first-degree relative with diabetes vs 3.2% without, odds ratio about 5; CDC, Preventing Chronic Disease 2005)

child_concerns.source: Development and behaviour concerns (Synthea has none) and the share already assessed

genetic_markers.source: Marker prevalence (FH about 1 in 250, BRCA about 1 in 300-400; HBB carriers higher in the region)

genetic_inheritance.source: A child of a carrier inherits a dominant marker with 50% chance

polygenic_heritability.source: Child's polygenic score = half the guardian's plus noise (variance kept at 1)

well_child_ages_months.source: AAP Bright Futures well-child visit ages

well_child_windows_days.source: Days before and after a due date that a visit still counts

history_years.source: Synthea keeps about 10 years of records

valid_ranges.source: Physiologically possible values; anything outside is set to missing

abnormal_results.source: HbA1c 6.5%+ (ADA diabetes), systolic 160+ (stage 2 hypertension), LDL 190+ (possible familial hypercholesterolaemia); no visit within 30 days counts as no follow-up

child_growth_concern.source: WHO growth references: BMI below the 5th or at/above the 97th percentile

prenatal_check_days.source: Antenatal visits at least every 6 weeks (WHO antenatal care model)

screened_months.source: A diabetes test in the last 3 years counts as screened (ADA)

data_sufficient.source: Enough records to compute a risk score

risk_cutoff_years.source: The risk model learns from records up to 2 years ago and what happened since

feature_lookback_days.source: Visits and lab results are counted over the last 2 years (the _2y features)

er_lookback_days.source: Emergency visits and abnormal results are looked for in the last 12 months

region_boundaries.source: Approximate boundaries used to put an OpenStreetMap place in Abu Dhabi, Al Ain or Al Dhafra region

calendar_years.source: Years of the UAE calendar downloaded (Ramadan, Eid, public holidays)

uae_hijri_holidays.source: UAE federal public holidays (Hijri month-day, Umm al-Qura calendar)
